title: Uses of Domestic Animals
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Bring products to class: an egg, milk, honey, a feather, a hide offcut, a little wool.

skills.key_step: The child names the food from domestic animals (milk from cows, goats and camels; eggs from hens, ducks and turkeys; meat; honey from bees; blood in some communities) and which animal gives each.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the uses of domestic animals.
floor.question: Which animal gives eggs?

representations: an animal and product matching game
steps: Name the animal that gives it.
Say whether one or many animals give it.

board.do: Draw arrows from the three animals.

misconceptions.ask: Which bird lays the eggs we eat?
misconceptions.repair: Ask the child to watch the flock: who sits on a nest?
Show a sample of wool and a sample of goat skin and ask where each comes from.

misconceptions.ask: Which of these does not give milk to the family?
misconceptions.repair: List the animals the family milks.

listen_for: Flowers make it and bees carry it
misconceptions.repair: Show a honeycomb: the bees store and change the nectar inside it.

checks.question: Which bird lays the eggs we usually eat?
Name two animals that give milk.
checks.answer: any two of cow, goat, camel

skills.key_step: The child relates domestic animals to all their uses: food, transport and work (donkeys, camels, oxen), manure, hides and wool, guarding (dogs), pest control (cats), income and cultural uses such as dowry.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the food domestic animals give.
floor.question: What food do bees give?

steps: Say how the family earns from it.

board.do: Draw a donkey with a cart.

misconceptions.ask: Why does a farmer keep oxen?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who ploughs the field in a family with no tractor.

misconceptions.ask: What is the main use of a donkey on many farms?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who carries water in the dry season.

listen_for: It cannot, it is only waste
misconceptions.ask: How can cow dung help a vegetable garden?
misconceptions.repair: Compare kale grown with and without manure.

misconceptions.ask: What do camels give families in northern Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of camel milk in a market in Isiolo.

checks.question: Give a use of cattle that is not food.
Why is dung useful?
checks.answer: it is manure for crops or fuel
